currency.name: Moroccan Dirham (MAD)
currency.notes: Closed currency, cannot export more than 1000 MAD. Always pay in MAD not CAD (avoids Dynamic Currency Conversion fee of 7-10%). Best ATM: BMCI (4000 MAD limit, 35 MAD fee).

useful_phrases: La, shukran - no, thank you (for henna ladies)
Compteur, s'il vous plaît - meter, please (for taxis)

info.sim_card: Inwi (avoid Orange). Get at RAK airport, ~$15 CAD.
info.drinking: Legal for non-Muslims in licensed venues (bars, restaurants, hotels). No public street drinking. Buy duty-free at YYZ (1 L pp). Big supermarkets (Carrefour, Acima) have alcohol sections. Riad De Vinci: confirm policy on rooftop drinking when checking in.
scams_to_expect: 'The square is closed' - it isn't, walk past
Free henna - not free, will demand 200-500 MAD
Taxi meter broken - walk to next taxi
Directions from strangers - they'll ask for money after, use Google Maps
Snake charmers at Jemaa - don't take photos unless you want to pay
info.moga_festival: Sep 30 - Oct 4, 2026 at Sofitel Mogador. MOGA OFF pre-parties run in the Essaouira medina Sep 27-29 (our dates). Electronic music blended with Gnaoua. Free medina parties, ticketed main event.

key_rules: Always bargain in markets, use the walk-away trick
Taxi meter must be on before you get in
Friday is cultural Sunday, but tourist areas run 7/7
